scripts.test: bun run test:vitest && bun run test:python
scripts.test:vitest: bun --bun vp test run --config ../vite.config.ts --project tooling tooling test/platform apps/client/test/e2e/harness apps/desktop/src-tauri/tests
scripts.test:python: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/development -p "test_*.py" && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/release -p "test_*.py"
scripts.typecheck: bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p typescript/tooling.json && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p typescript/browser-tests.json
